header.title: Bringing real-world learning into the classroom.
header.copy: A structured 26-week programme that complements academic learning with essential life skills. Ikigyan gives teachers ready-to-use learning experiences, activities and resources that help children discover, think and apply knowledge beyond the textbook.

journey.imageAlt: A winding path connecting a school, a calendar, a puzzle book, a globe and a child climbing stairs made of books toward a star, illustrating the 26-week programme.
journey.heading: The 26-week Ikigyan learning journey.

included.heading: Everything a school needs to get started.
